about: Kansas state grant calls entered by hand from each program's own page: Kansas has no state catalog here (docs/state-coverage.md), so this is not a statewide list. grantmatch/local.py checks this file and turns each entry into a Kansas program record; the weekly page watcher rereads every page. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date.

programs.title: Early Childhood Block Grant, SFY28 competition
programs.agency: Kansas Children's Cabinet and Trust Fund
programs.objectives: Competitive grants for preschool and research-based child development services, with a focus on underserved areas and children needing additional supports.
programs.who: The Cabinet says block grant funds go to school districts, child care centers, Head Start sites and community programs that provide preschool and research-based child development services. Read the competition page for who may apply.
programs.application: See the Cabinet's SFY28 grant competition page.
programs.award: The amount isn't stated here; see the competition page.
programs.subjects: Early childhood; Preschool; Child development; Education; Families
